items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: Bob and I had worked in L.A. together backing up a folk singer named Chad Mitchell.

ctx.x: And producer. And Bob and I had worked in L.A. together backing up a folk singer named Chad Mitchell. And so we had become really good friends and also his partner in that was a guitarist named Stuart Scharf, and we all became very, very close friends. And Bob was like an older brother to me. A little like a mentor as much as a guy who just really liked me, we got along great and they started hiring me and all that stuff — when I wasn’t on the road with Gary. And I came to visit him in Pennsylvania in the Poconos…
What was a typical gig in the Poconos like at that time?
